sql.smartlist.getOwnAndShared: select s.*, ot.object_type, cot.object_type_id, ot1.object_type as view_object_type, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) as owner from flow.smartlist s inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = s.company_object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot1 on ot1.id = s.view_object_type_id inner join flow.user u on u.id = s.owner_id where cot.company_id = :companyId and (s.owner_id = :userId or s.shared is true) and s.archived is not true
sql.smartlist.getAll: select s.*, ot.object_type, cot.object_type_id, ot1.object_type as view_object_type, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) as owner from flow.smartlist s inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = s.company_object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot1 on ot1.id = s.view_object_type_id inner join flow.user u on u.id = s.owner_id where cot.company_id = :companyId and s.archived is not true
sql.smartlist.getById: select s.*, ot.object_type, cot.object_type_id, ot1.object_type as view_object_type, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) as owner from flow.smartlist s inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = s.company_object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot1 on ot1.id = s.view_object_type_id inner join flow.user u on u.id = s.owner_id where s.id = :smartlistId and cot.company_id = :companyId and (s.owner_id = :userId or s.shared or :canViewAll) and s.archived is not true
sql.smartlist.getSharedByObjectType: -- selecting smartlists via smartlist_field_assignment makes sure we get smartlists with at least 1 field select distinct s.id, s.name, s.company_object_type_id, cot.object_type_id, s.shared, s.owner_id, s.date_created, s.date_modified, s.created_by_id, s.modified_by_id, s.archived from flow.smartlist_field_assignment sfa inner join flow.smartlist s on s.id = sfa.smartlist_id inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = s.company_object_type_id where cot.company_id = :companyId and s.archived is not true and sfa.archived is not true and s.view_object_type_id = :objectTypeId and (s.shared is true or s.owner_id = :userId) order by s.name
sql.smartlist.update: update flow.smartlist set name = :name, company_object_type_id = :companyObjectTypeId, shared = :shared, view_object_type_id = :viewObjectTypeId, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now(), project_details = :projectDetails where id = :id;

sql.smartlist.updateRequirement: update flow.smartlist_requirement set operator_type_id = :operatorTypeId, requirement_value = :requirementValue, secondary_requirement_value = :secondaryRequirementValue, data_type_requirement_id = :dataTypeRequirementId, list_of_value_id = :listOfValueId, list_of_value_ids = array[ :listOfValueIds ]::int[], system_list_option_id = :systemListOptionId, custom_sql_option_id = :customSqlOptionId, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now(), project_details_column = :projectDetailsColumn where id = :id;
sql.smartlist.deleteRequirement: update flow.smartlist_requirement set archived = true, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :requirementId
sql.smartlist.getLogic: select sl.id, sl.smartlist_id, sl.smartlist_requirement_id, sl.operation_type_id, ot.operation_type, ot.operation_code, sl.sql_order, sl.created_by_id, sl.date_created, sl.modified_by_id, sl.date_modified, sl.archived, sr.display_order from flow.smartlist_logic sl left join flow.operation_type ot on ot.id = sl.operation_type_id left join flow.smartlist_requirement sr on sr.id = sl.smartlist_requirement_id where sl.smartlist_id = :smartlistId and sl.archived is not true order by sl.sql_order;
sql.smartlist.archiveLogic: update flow.smartlist_logic set archived = true, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where smartlist_id = :smartlistId;
sql.smartlist.updateLogic: insert into flow.smartlist_logic (smartlist_id, smartlist_requirement_id, operation_type_id, sql_order, created_by_id) values (:smartlistId, :smartlistRequirementId, :operationTypeId, :sqlOrder, :userId);
